messages:
Maria (PS): Heads up: Nimbus marketplace reports disappearing hourly spikes when we ingest minute-level events. They think entitlements sometimes land late (~5-10m) and credits don't match. Can we regroup to decide a reconciliation path?

Josh (Infra): I noticed similar gaps in logs. Suspect our ingestion windowing + timezone rounding. Can you drop a few sample payloads?

Maria (PS): Shared bundle: https://s3.redwood/nimbus/minute-samples.zip. Partner says entitlements can activate a few minutes after the first usage event.

Devin (Billing): If entitlements activate late, hourly rollups can show negative deltas. My initial proposals: (a) idempotent upsert keyed on event_id, (b) a 15m entitlement grace period when attributing credits, (c) include record provenance in audit logs.

Anna (Eng): Concur. For rollups, include minute events whose timestamp >= hour_start - 15m to cover late entitlements. Also honour partner-supplied "claimed_by" or "source_account" if present.

Josh (Infra): Current lambda buckets by floor(ts,1h) and drops minute granularity. Two options: 1) persist raw events and run streaming rollups from a materialized view, or 2) accept partner-provided hour buckets (fragile). Persisting raw adds ~+8% storage but preserves correctness.

Devin (Billing): For retro adjustments we need a clear policy: auto-apply credits if adjustment <= 100 token-equivalent AND within 24h; otherwise push to ops review queue and log in billing audit. Adjustments must show provenance in Console.

Maria (PS): @Anna please draft a short replay/backfill playbook and list audit artifacts we must capture. Nimbus will prepare a re-send script for minute events.

Anna (Eng): Draft playbook v0:
1) Partner replays minute CSV with columns: event_id,timestamp,usage_units,entitlement_id,tenant_id/accountId
2) Redwood ingests into raw_events (idempotent upsert on event_id)
3) Backfill worker recomputes impacted hourly aggregates and emits adjustment records (adjustment_id,reason,delta,source_event_ids)
4) Billing auto-applies credit if adjustment <= 100 tokens AND within 24h; otherwise route to manual review queue
5) All adjustments write an immutable audit record and surface in Console -> Billing -> Adjustments with provenance

Josh (Infra): Also found a field mismatch: Nimbus uses `accountId` while our pipeline expects `tenant_id`. We'll add a per-partner mapping in translation layer so partners don't have to change immediately.

Maria (PS): Nimbus agreed to mapping. They want reconciliation visible in Console within 30m of ingestion. Can we commit to that SLA?

Josh (Infra): 30m is tight but doable if we enable streaming-aggregator + materialized view for partner:nimbus. We'll need a short canary and estimate infra +0.2 RPS per active account; ops impact should be minimal.

Devin (Billing): Agreed summary: 30m visibility, 24h auto-credit window, 15m entitlement grace, partner-to-Redwood mapping support, replay/playbook + required audit artifacts. I'll own the RFC for billing adjustment rules and thresholds.

marketplace-bot: Scheduled change: enable streaming-aggregator for partner:nimbus on 2024-11-12 02:00 UTC.

Maria (PS): Thanks all. I'll share the playbook and checklist with Nimbus. Please flag any missing items. :thumbsup:
